messages:
Maria: Quick handoff for Vega-13B quantization experiments. TL;DR: int8 looks promising — ~2.1x per-token cost reduction vs fp16, latency regresses modestly, small quality delta. Suggest a 15% canary with automatic fallback to fp16 on quality/safety regressions. Who can own GTN guidance?

Anil: Can you drop unit economics in $/1M tokens and the eval sample sizes? PMs want a single number to brief with.

Maria: Pasted the run context and raw numbers below (prod-like batching & routing distribution):
```
fp16 (baseline): $0.20 / 1k tokens -> $200 / 1M tokens
int8 (quant runtime): $0.095 / 1k tokens -> $95 / 1M tokens
=> ~2.1x cost reduction per-token
Throughput (tokens/s): fp16 1200 tok/s, int8 1020 tok/s
Latency (chat route): p50 60ms -> 66ms, p99 200ms -> 236ms
Eval set: 1500 production-sampled prompts, 400 safety/edge prompts
Quality proxy (NLU-MRR): 0.000 -> -0.009 (absolute)
Safety fails: 4 -> 6 (out of 400)
```

Sarah: Hm, safety delta is non-trivial. Any pattern to the extra failures?

Maria: Mostly long multi-hop reasoning with extended context — quantization amplifies subtle tokenization/attention truncation artifacts. Not catastrophic, but visible. We tried a quick mitigation: enabling prefix (KV) caching for long sessions dropped the NLU delta to -0.004 and safety fails to 5/400. Worth including as a canary mitigation.

deploy-bot: deploy/vega-13b-int8 smoke tests passed (ci-4987). Canary flag slice=internal-only.

Leo: For GTN slide I want: 1) clear $/1M token numbers, 2) one-row scorecard, 3) recommended rollout + rollback triggers. Can you paste a compact scorecard here?

Maria: Scorecard (compact):
```
Metric | fp16 | int8 | delta
$/1M tok | $200 | $95 | -$105
NLU-MRR proxy | 0.0 | -0.009 | -0.9%
p99 latency | 200ms | 236ms | +36ms
Safety fails/400 | 4 | 6 | +2
Recommendation: Canary 15% (slice internal + canary flag), gating: NLU delta > -1.5% OR safety fails > baseline+3 -> rollback. Promote if NLU delta > -1.5% and safety <= baseline+1 for 24h.
```

Anil: I suggest a routing rule: mobile low-latency chat routes keep fp16; background large-batch or embeddings jobs go int8. That should reduce user-facing risk and preserve cost wins.

Maria: Agreed. We have a prototype flag `model_variant_preference` that supports priorities [fp16,int8]. I'll author a short RFC for circuit-breaker condition thresholds (NRR/quality delta, safety spike, latency SLO breach).

Sarah: I'll own the safety gating and wire up alerts/dashboards for the canary. Will create canary-specific eval slices (long-context, multi-step reasoning, safety-edge).

Leo: I'll draft the GTN slide and one-slide runbook for PS/PMs, include the routing suggestion and rollback thresholds. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Maria: Action items: (1) Leo — GTN slide and runbook, (2) Anil — add routing rules to canary config, (3) Sarah — safety eval dashboard + gating, (4) Infra — enable canary flag at 15% with auto-fallback to fp16 and metrics alerts. I'll write the quick canary playbook after lunch and post it in #eng-ml. :thumbsup:

Maria: One more note — recommend we start with internal-only traffic for 24h, then expand to external beta if metrics hold. Also include a short smoke eval harness that runs the 400 safety prompts every hour during canary.

Anil: +1. Please include the exact SQL to pull the eval sample in the playbook so PMs can reproduce.

Maria: Will do. Filing runbook now.
